messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "inform healthcare provider if 65 years of age or older"
set: ["inform healthcare provider if 65 years of age or older", "inform healthcare provider if pregnant or planning pregnancy", "inform healthcare provider about liver problems", "inform healthcare provider about Asian descent", "inform healthcare provider about thyroid problems", "inform healthcare provider about kidney problems", "inform healthcare provider about all medical conditions", "inform healthcare provider about unexplained muscle aches or weakness", "healthcare provider or adult caregiver", "inform testing provider of medications taken", "tell healthcare provider if taking prescription or over-the-counter medicines", "tell healthcare provider if taking vitamins or herbal supplements", "call healthcare provider or 911 if noticing trouble sleeping", "inform healthcare providers before surgery or procedure", "call your healthcare provider if this happens", "call healthcare provider if symptoms are severe"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
